productionSurfaceOverride.deformationRule: Scale only the rebased middle shaft along local -Y; translate but never longitudinally scale the rigid distal source region.
productionSurfaceOverride.thicknessRule: Use a shared relative X/Z shaft morph whose influence tapers to zero at both clipped boundary rings; shaft thickness never scales either rigid end or any part's longitudinal Y scale.
productionSurfaceOverride.knobSizeRule: Expose separate 1.00-1.62 arm/leg knob controls that uniformly enlarge authored knob regions in XYZ. Pin the Ivory Bone distal endpoint to its semantic socket and never resize Ivory Rattle insertion tips.
productionSurfaceOverride.volumeRule: Derive a quadratic closed-volume polynomial from each final Float32 shaft and solve animation plus authored thickness together; clamp influence at -0.98 only when fixed collars make the requested thin+long volume physically impossible.
productionSurfaceOverride.normalRule: Use derivative flat normals for the supplied face-normal topology so lighting follows the moving thickness morph.
productionSurfaceOverride.fallbackNote: The procedural double-lobe component tree below remains a tested fallback contract, not the production player surface.

terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Use measurable 3D graphics terms. Avoid vague words unless they are paired with concrete geometry/material/shader parameters.

referenceCamera.note: For likeness work, solve the reference camera (forge/stage1_intake/solve_camera_pose.py) so the review render aligns with the photo and the reference can be projected. Confirm by overlay review.

objectClass.notes: A reusable visual component for a character rig, not a literal anatomical bone or an independently skinned character.

reasoning: The visible target is structurally simple but requires a nontrivial deformation contract, smooth continuous end forms, stable attachments and multi-angle verification.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Choose simple/moderate/complex/ultra-complex from observed structure, not from a hardcoded domain.

detailInventory.note: Enumerate every identity-defining small detail before authoring the spec. Each detail must map to a component.localFeatures entry or material.localOverrides entry, never prose only. Use forge/stage1_intake/build_detail_inventory.py to scan zones.

details.description: Endpoint shapes stay rigid under length deformation.

anatomy.note: Only meaningful when objectClass.primaryDomain is character or hybrid. Set applies=true and fill from forge/stage1_intake/extract_landmarks.py. See grimoire/character/reconstruction.md and grimoire/character/likeness_maximization.md.

definitionOfDone: One reusable factory instantiates the source-derived Ivory Bone or Ivory Rattle surface from shared synchronous geometry.
Length changes from 0.55x to 1.75x affect only the measured shaft span and distal placement while both source end regions retain local scale and shape.
The component integrates into all arm and leg segment anchors without adding skeleton joints or breaking existing sockets, IK, keyframes, proportions or gameplay collision.
Neutral, compressed, elongated, side and rear captures show connected volume with no gaps, collapsed silhouette or faceted highlight banding.

actionReadiness.contract: Every macro/meso component should be generated as a stable named Object3D pivot node with a mesh child, action metadata, optional sockets, collider proxy, and destruction metadata.
requiredComponentFields: attachment for child appendages, connectors, limbs, tubes, handles, legs, horns, wings, branches, or cables
authoringRules: Do not collapse independently movable parts into one mesh.
Put transforms on component pivot groups, not only on raw meshes.
For attached child parts, put the pivot at the semantic root/socket and build visible geometry from localStart to localEnd.
Represent hinge, socket, detachable, and breakable intent even when no animation is implemented yet.
Use simplified collider proxies for runtime physics instead of visual mesh colliders by default.
Length deformation mutates only the nested shaft transform and distal follower positions; endpoint knobble scales and quaternions remain invariant.
The component introduces no THREE.Bone nodes and attaches to the existing semantic skeleton.

destructionPolicy.fractureGroupNaming: Use stable semantic names such as body-shell, left-hinge, glass-panel, branch-segment.
destructionPolicy.debrisStrategy: Prefer detachable component groups and a small number of procedural fragments over random mesh explosion.

assumptions: Backside form is resolved as rotationally symmetric for the shaft and bilaterally symmetric for each knobble.
Exact radius and length are intentionally runtime-authored options rather than reference measurements.
Animation controls remain 0.55–1.75; composition with Character Lab is verified across the component-safe 0.319–2.765 range.
